newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Madagascar says will privatise mining industry.
newsitem.headline: Madagascar says will privatise mining industry.

text.p: Madagascar's mining authorities said on Wednesday they were committed to major reforms in the mining sector that would lead to privatisation.

Alain Daso, a senior official in the mines and energy ministry, told a conference on oils and minerals in Grand Baie, Mauritius, that Madagascar saw the private sector as they key to economic growth and was doing everything to encourage it.

"In the context of privatisation, Madagascar has concluded with the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund a Structural Adjustment Programme where the state disinvests in the productive sectors in favour of the private sector," Daso told the conference.
He said Madagascar would launch a new economic development policy and strategy giving impetus to the private sector.
Daso said Madagascar understood that the best way to boost growth in the mining sector was to limit government intervention and promote its role as facilitator.
He said Madagascar's mining sector accounted for only 3.0 percent of Gross Domestic Product and 1.0 percent of total exports. But he saw mining potential on the island.
Daso said Canadian, U.S. and South African firms were prospecting in Madagascar.
